recommendations.title: Evidence-Based Vaccination Implementation Strategy for Medicaid Populations
recommendations.implementation_guidance: Implement a comprehensive vaccination strategy for Medicaid-enrolled patients that includes: 1) Assess vaccination status at every clinical encounter using electronic health records or immunization information systems; 2) Strongly recommend needed vaccines using presumptive language (e.g., 'Today you are due for these vaccines' rather than 'Would you like vaccines today?'); 3) Address vaccine hesitancy with motivational interviewing techniques and culturally appropriate education materials; 4) Implement standing orders to allow nursing staff to administer vaccines without physician examination; 5) Use reminder/recall systems (text messages, phone calls, letters) to notify patients of due or overdue vaccines; 6) Schedule dedicated vaccination-only appointments when needed; 7) Offer extended hours or weekend vaccination clinics to accommodate working patients; 8) Implement simultaneous administration of multiple needed vaccines when appropriate; 9) Document vaccine refusals and reasons in the medical record for follow-up at subsequent visits; 10) Provide vaccine information statements in the patient's preferred language; 11) Utilize every opportunity to vaccinate including sick visits when appropriate; 12) Report all administered vaccines to state/regional immunization information systems; 13) Implement quality improvement processes to track and improve vaccination rates; 14) Address transportation barriers through mobile vaccination services or transportation assistance when possible.
recommendations.expected_outcomes: Increased vaccination rates, reduced vaccine-preventable diseases, decreased healthcare disparities in immunization coverage, reduced emergency department visits and hospitalizations for vaccine-preventable conditions, improved herd immunity in vulnerable communities, increased patient satisfaction with preventive care, reduced costs associated with vaccine-preventable diseases.
recommendations.target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals across the lifespan, with particular focus on children, pregnant individuals, adults with chronic conditions, and older adults who may face barriers to vaccination.
recommendations.citation: Kroger A, Bahta L, Long S, Sanchez P. General Best Practice Guidelines for Immunization. Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP). https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines/hcp/acip-recs/general-recs/downloads/general-recs.pdf. Accessed May 29, 2025.
